description: Single tweet · public-goal milestone post for hitting 75 verified vendors (May 13) and pushing for 100 by end-of-week (Sunday May 17). Two-way ask (submit yourself OR tag a vendor) makes the post easy to engage with for both vendors AND visitors who don't sell anything but know merchants. The Sunday deadline creates urgency without feeling pressured (5 days to find/recruit 25 vendors = 5/day, achievable based on today's pace).
tweets:
